findings.verification: An opaque preferred disk is skipped; confirmed Universal and SSD disks remain ordered candidates. Unknown-only disks fail closed; HTTP and network exceptions propagate.

findings.finding: Malformed flavor availability_zones aborted role preflight

findings.verification: One service-port reservation helper is used in both checks. VM ports are added independently; per-node port and app floating-IP quotas are rechecked. Resume credits count only saved pending resources in their own pool.
